visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short black hair and round black-rimmed glasses speaks directly to a large professional condenser microphone. She is wearing a dark grey sequined cardigan over a white high-neck top and small silver hoop earrings. The background consists of vertical greyish-white fabric curtains. (2) The camera angle shifts slightly as the woman becomes more expressive, raising her hand to her forehead to mimic applying a product. She smiles and speaks with high energy while gesturing with her hands. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom center of the frame. (3) The scene transitions to a static white screen featuring a stylized "DR" logo and text in Traditional Chinese "美上美皮膚科診所" and English "DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC". audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with an energetic and authoritative tone. Speech rate is moderate to fast. There is no background music. The ambient noise floor is extremely clean, indicating a studio environment. (2) The speaker's pitch rises slightly as she emphasizes specific words like "逼他擦A酸" (forced him to apply A-acid). Her articulation is very clear. (3) The vocal track continues with a slightly humorous and confident inflection while recounting her son's skin care journey. The voice remains the primary focus of the mix with high clarity. (4) As the narration ends, a bright, upbeat electronic pop jingle fades in quickly. It features a fast-tempo synth rhythm and distinct percussive beats. The vocals cease entirely, and the music becomes the dominant audio element for the final few seconds before a hard cut.

It positions the speaker as an expert authority while promoting the DRX Dermatology Clinic through professional branding and contact information at the end.
